headlines.title: Florida poll: Republicans lead in the races for governor and Senate
headlines.description: The new survey shows the state’s Hispanic voters shifting away from President Donald Trump after Republicans made gains in 2024.

headlines.title: Susan Collins and Troy Jackson clash over Trump and seniority in Maine’s first Senate debate
headlines.description: The two candidates clashed repeatedly over their records and national politics in the first of four debates in the key battleground race.

headlines.title: Republican John James seeks some distance from Trump in Michigan governor debate
headlines.description: Democrat Jocelyn Benson repeatedly tried to tie James, a Trump-backed congressman, to the president during their first showdown ahead of the November election.

headlines.title: Georgia governor candidates spar over the economy and Trump in lone debate
headlines.description: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms and Republican Rick Jackson clashed Tuesday night during their only scheduled debate of this fall’s race for governor in Georgia.

headlines.title: Zach Lahn’s residency history and Rob Sand’s party come under fire in first Iowa governor debate
headlines.description: Lahn, the Republican nominee, and Sand, the Democratic state auditor, are running to succeed retiring GOP Gov. Kim Reynolds.

headlines.title: Israel Marks Three Years Since Oct. 7 Attacks With Remembrances
headlines.description: Israel is marking a somber milestone, three years since the Oct. 7 attacks, pausing to remember the deadliest day in its history. A moment of silence was held for the 1,200 killed and 251 kidnapped in the 2023 Hamas-led attack. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Exclusive: Promising Brain Cancer Vaccine Gives Hope to Patients
headlines.description: Each year, some 15,000 Americans are diagnosed with glioblastoma, the deadliest form of brain cancer. Only 7% live more than five years but a new vaccine still in development could offer patients more time. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Christa Pike now conscious and speaking following failed execution
headlines.description: Christa Pike, a Tennessee inmate who was unconscious and on a ventilator after a failed execution, is now awake and speaking, according to her lawyers. In a statement, attorneys for Pike said she remains handcuffed and shackled.

headlines.title: What Trump's new executive order on diesel means
headlines.description: President Trump signed an executive order aimed at bringing down diesel prices by easing restrictions on red-dye diesel. NBC News' Brian Cheung breaks down what is in the order and what it means for Americans.

headlines.title: They were a historically bad team. Now they’re a threat to make the World Series.
headlines.description: The Chicago White Sox are up 2-0 in the American League Division Series, a shocking turnaround after three straight 100-loss seasons.

headlines.title: Live updates: The absolute best October Prime Day deals, hand-picked by a shopping reporter
headlines.description: NBC Selected editors are tracking the best October Prime Day deals on the final day of Amazon’s sale, with live updates on deals actually worth buying.
